event.title: Ukrainian Drone Strike Causes Major Fire at Saint Petersburg Warehouse
event.canonical_title: Ukrainian Drone Strike Causes Major Fire at Saint Petersburg Warehouse
event.summary: A Ukrainian drone strike ignited a significant fire at a Wildberries warehouse near Saint Petersburg on July 24. The blaze produced thick smoke that spread across the city and led to temporary disruptions at Pulkovo Airport, as reported by Russian authorities.

timeline.title: Russian Strikes Near Kyiv Result in Four Fatalities During Zelensky's Visit to Serbia
timeline.summary: Russian missile strikes in the Kyiv region have killed four people, including a child, as local authorities reported multiple casualties. The attacks occurred shortly after Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky's arrival in Serbia for a significant visit. The strikes have raised concerns about Ukraine's air defense capabilities amidst ongoing military tensions.
key_facts: Four people killed, including a child, in Russian missile strikes near Kyiv.
The attacks coincided with President Zelensky's visit to Serbia.
Local authorities reported multiple casualties and damage from falling debris.

timeline.title: Escalating Attacks Leave Casualties in Ukraine and Russia Amid New Military Deals
timeline.summary: Recent drone and missile strikes have resulted in multiple casualties in both Ukraine and Russia. In Ukraine, at least four people, including a child, were killed in attacks on Kyiv and surrounding regions. Concurrently, Ukraine has reportedly finalized a deal to purchase ATACMS missile systems from Turkey to bolster its defense capabilities. On the Russian side, drone attacks have led to fatalities in Belgorod, with reports indicating that five people were killed.
key_facts: At least four people, including a child, killed in Russian strikes on Kyiv.
Ukraine has finalized a deal to buy ATACMS missile systems from Turkey.
Five fatalities reported in Belgorod due to Ukrainian drone attacks.

timeline.title: Deadly Ukrainian Drone Attack in Russia Claims 13 Lives
timeline.summary: A Ukrainian drone attack on the industrial city of Nizhnekamsk in Tatarstan has resulted in at least 13 fatalities and numerous injuries. This incident marks one of the deadliest strikes on Russian territory since the onset of the conflict. Reports indicate that the attack targeted industrial and civilian sites, with local authorities confirming the casualties and injuries.
key_facts: Attack is one of the deadliest since the war began
Numerous injuries reported, with figures varying from 48 to 75

event_overview.title: About Russia-Ukraine War
event_overview.subject: Russia-Ukraine War
event_overview.summary: The Russia-Ukraine War is an ongoing armed conflict between Ukraine and the Russian Federation, rooted in fighting that began in eastern Ukraine in 2014 and greatly escalated with Russia’s full-scale invasion on February 24, 2022. It has involved conventional ground operations as well as long-range missile and drone attacks, and has produced a major humanitarian and displacement crisis.

facts.label: Origins and escalation
facts.value: Conflict-related humanitarian operations in eastern Ukraine expanded in 2014; Russia’s full-scale invasion in February 2022 transformed the conflict into a nationwide emergency.

facts.label: Main parties and geography
facts.value: The war principally involves Ukraine and the Russian Federation, with military operations taking place in Ukraine and attacks increasingly affecting areas beyond the immediate front line.

facts.label: International legal position
facts.value: On March 2, 2022, the UN General Assembly deplored Russia’s aggression against Ukraine, demanded that Russia end its use of force and withdraw its forces, and reaffirmed Ukraine’s sovereignty and territorial integrity within its internationally recognized borders.

facts.label: International Court of Justice proceedin
facts.value: In provisional measures issued on March 16, 2022 in Ukraine v. Russian Federation, the International Court of Justice ordered Russia to suspend military operations begun on February 24, 2022, while stating that the order did not decide the case’s merits.

facts.label: Humanitarian impact
facts.value: The war has driven large-scale displacement, damaged civilian infrastructure and left millions of people in need of assistance; UNHCR describes it as an ongoing full-scale war and humanitarian emergency.

event_overview.scope_note: The selected Muninn timeline focuses on specified late-July and early-August 2026 security developments, including cross-border drone or missile incidents and strikes; it does not aim to provide a complete account of the war’s military, diplomatic, legal, or humanitarian history.
